backups.title: A record of every change.

codex.label: Codex
codex.title: Your boot menu. With Codex.
codex.subtitle: The same verified functions, directly from your Codex chat.

report.label: Change result
report.applied: The listed configuration steps were verified after writing.
report.partial: Some deviations remain. Review the journal and its backup.
report.rolledBack: The affected targets were rolled back. See the journal for details.
report.bootTestExplanation: A successful boot can only be confirmed with a separate boot test.

preview.label: Change preview
preview.explanation: Review all affected targets. Before writing, BootPilot creates a backup and checks that the original state still matches.
preview.expired: The plan has expired. Create a new preview.
preview.noCurrentSnapshot: No current scan is available. Refresh and create a new preview.
preview.started: This plan has already been started or completed.
preview.noChanges: This plan contains no visible changes and cannot be applied here.

overview.emptyNotEvidence: An empty result does not confirm that operating systems are missing.
overview.completeScanNeeded: A complete scan is needed for a reliable assessment.
overview.noValidatedLinux: No validated Linux installation was found for a new direct entry. Installers are not installed Linux systems.
overview.noFindings: The diagnosis reports no additional findings. This does not confirm a successful boot test.

menu.unsupported: Writing this GRUB configuration is not supported.
menu.refreshHelp: Refresh the scan to see supported settings.
menu.orderExplanation: This order is independent of the default selection in the GRUB menu.
menu.completeFirmwareNeeded: A complete, current firmware scan is required.
menu.title: Menu title
menu.noInstallerUse: An existing ISO or live installer is not used as an installed Linux system.

backups.title: Your backups
backups.explanation: A recovery is first checked as a concrete plan. It affects only the targets of that specific change.
backups.notLoaded: Backups have not been loaded yet. Choose “Reload backups”.
backups.emptyHelp: Once a change starts, its backup and journal will appear here.
backups.incompleteHelp: This change has not been recorded as completed. Its state must be checked before recovery.

codex.title: BootPilot in Codex
codex.setupHelp: Setup backs up the Codex configuration and preserves existing MCP servers. No additional API key is needed.
codex.restart: Fully restart Codex. Only a measured connection test can confirm the connection.
codex.exampleStatus: “Show my boot options and open checks.”
codex.exampleRestore: “Show the preview for the latest recovery.”
codex.exampleHelp: Every change in Codex also requires a reviewed plan. BootPilot does not restart the PC automatically.

app.footer: BootPilot manages existing boot options. Configuration results and a successful boot test are reported separately.

snapshot.staleHelp: The last scan remains visible. Refresh the status before preparing another change.
snapshot.firstScanHelp: Choose “Refresh” to read the existing boot configuration. Windows may ask for administrator permissions for protected queries.
